roof.headline: Learning to work on the roof.
roof.title: One movement. A whole roofing workflow.
roof.imageAlt: Author-recorded G1 with a tool on the laboratory slope; overhead safety support and operator remain visible.
roof.sceneAlt: Future concept: a humanoid and worker share a sloped roof with tools, materials, and a connected sensing path.
roof.description: The current work demonstrates selected slope-aware motion primitives and tool positioning with a supervised G1. Functional tool contact, material handling, and job coordination remain connections to develop with control, tool-design, robotics, construction, and safety expertise. A roof with a humanoid, worker, tool, and stacked materials depicts the future workflow. The current motion clips do not demonstrate fastening or a complete autonomous roofing job.
